armSilhouette: two skin arms; one big lilac sword arm (main_r) gripping the pale violet giant katana; four smaller lilac auxiliary arms fanned behind the shoulders (rear_* upper pair, rear2_* lower pair); two dull bronze-grey support hands (support_r, main_l) cradling a dull-tinted Raiden from below

palette.armour: arm_lilac plates, arm_shade sides, arm_deep joints, gold_dull trims, arm_tomoe/gold_dull tomoe discs
palette.katana: blade_pale body, blade_edge cutting edge on model -X, blade_core fuller and spine on +X, grip_dark grip, gold_dull tsuba/habaki/wraps
palette.support: hand_dull, hand_dull_dark, nail_glow nails and seams
palette.raiden: skin/ribbon *_dull copies tinted #A098AC while the armour is at least half formed

blades: Every blade frame is authored as (tip, edge); the edge (model -X) faces the direction of travel in all cuts. Rotation keys (giant_weapon, *_hand) are slerped.

lightning.materials: violet geometry and exposed white seams
lightning.hands: exact hand pivot/rotation/scale; charge, inward focus, contact release; smaller rear hands never emit large release crowns; the clap charge sits on the two support hands
lightning.chakra: sparse outer-rim forks; idle intermittent, charged attacks sustained; empty centre preserves face visibility

targetSlam: dull support hand, palm down; grows from age 1, falls from age 15, contacts the ground at hazard age 18, removed at age 32
integration: Call rig/init from load, rig/spawn and rig/tick as the real boss at its feet. rdAnim selects a state; private rdRigT resets on rdAnim/rdPhase changes. rig/select/<clip> also applies rig/skin_dull or rig/skin_normal for the current rdPhase. rig/flash is optional body-hit feedback. rig/cleanup deletes all parts. Supplied skin remains byte-identical.
